moments.title: Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games in Full Swing
moments.blurb: The Commonwealth Games are currently underway in Glasgow, Scotland, running from July 23rd to August 2nd, with athletics events beginning today, July 27th.

angles.name: Athletics Kicks Off
angles.copy: Day 4 of the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow! Athletics events officially kick off today, July 27th. Who are you backing for gold? #Glasgow2026

angles.name: Team UK Support
angles.copy: The Commonwealth Games are lighting up Glasgow! Tune in to support Team UK as they go for glory across various sports until August 2nd. #CommonwealthGames

moments.title: The Hundred Cricket Season Underway
moments.blurb: The 100-ball cricket tournament, The Hundred, is currently in full swing across England and Wales, running from July 21st to August 16th, with double-header matches happening daily.

angles.name: Catch the Action
angles.copy: The Hundred is bringing the heat! Cricket's fastest format continues across the UK this week. Who's your team for 2026? #TheHundred

angles.name: Welsh Fire Update
angles.copy: Big week for Welsh Fire in The Hundred! Catch all the action as they battle it out on the pitch. Keep up with the scores on Nation Radio Wales!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Equal Chart Record
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' has made UK chart history today, July 26th, by equalling Frankie Laine's 'I Believe' as the longest-running UK Number 1 single ever, with 18 non-consecutive weeks at the top.

angles.name: Historic Chart Battle
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is officially the joint longest-running UK Number 1 single ever! Can they break the record next week?

angles.name: Record Breaker
angles.copy: 18 weeks at Number 1! 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender and Olivia Dean has equalled a legendary chart record. What's your favourite long-running chart-topper?

moments.title: Fourth UK Heatwave Expected Next Week
moments.blurb: A fourth UK heatwave is forecast for next week, with temperatures potentially soaring to 35-40°C in parts of England and Wales, while the north is expected to remain cooler.

angles.name: Heatwave Incoming
angles.copy: Get ready, another heatwave is on its way next week! Temperatures could hit 40°C in parts of the UK. Stay hydrated and stay cool! #UKWeather

angles.name: North-South Split
angles.copy: While the south braces for another potential heatwave next week, the north of the UK is looking at cooler, cloudier conditions. Which side of the split are you on?

moments.title: Major UK Festivals Wrap Up Today
moments.blurb: Latitude Festival in Suffolk, Truck Festival in Oxfordshire, and WOMAD Festival in Wiltshire all conclude today, July 26th, after a weekend of music and arts.

angles.name: Festival Farewell

angles.name: Suffolk Festival Vibes
angles.copy: The fields of Henham Park bid farewell to Latitude Festival today. What an incredible weekend of music and arts in Suffolk!
